label: LTI response, state space
text: EN.O.A4.1.5 Linear time-invariant system response: impulse response, transfer function, frequency response. Fourier and Laplace transforms are MA (uses MA.O.A4). State space ẋ = Ax + Bu, y = Cx + Du and G(s) = C(sI − A)⁻¹B + D, for LTI plants.

warrant.standard: Prediction matches measurement; compliance test passes
warrant.defeaters: Lumped assumption fails; parasitics; thermal drift
